example.title: John and Anna O'Sullivan Farmstead, granary

brief: Small frame granary 20 ft by 16 ft built as a lean-to against the side of a limestone barn, sided in vertical boards nailed to girts, weathered silver-grey with ghosts of red paint and rotting along the bottom. A shallow shed roof of rusty corrugated metal slopes away from the barn wall; a plank door near the barn and small square hinged-panel openings in the other walls. The floor is raised on round timber piers; dead weeds, stacked rusty pipe and roofing tin lie around it. (Granary lean-to; nearest vocabulary type is frame_machine_shed.)
